segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Dana. I pulled up the order form in the CRM. We have 48 seats for the analytics module and 6 admin seats, with a target go-live of March 18. Is that still accurate?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yep, that's right. We may add two more admins later, but for launch it's 6. I mostly wanted to confirm the invoice timing and the services line.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Sure. The annual software is $57,600, and the implementation package is $8,400. Billing would issue the first invoice on signature, net 30. If you sign by February 14, the due date would be March 16.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. Our finance team asked if the implementation can be billed separately, same net 30 terms, but dated after the kickoff.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes, that should be fine. Kickoff is tentatively February 21, so we can set the services invoice date to February 22. I'll note that for deal desk before I send the final order form.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great. On the contract term, it's 12 months, not 24, correct?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Correct, 12 months starting March 18 through March 17 next year. Renewal is annual, and the pricing sheet has a 5% cap on the first renewal increase.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That works. One more thing: our procurement group needs the PO number on the invoice. It'll be PO-41782, but they're still routing it.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: No problem. If you have the PO by signature, we'll include it. If it comes a day or two after, billing can add it before they send the invoice.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sounds good. Send the updated order form today if you can, and I'll route it to legal. I don't expect many changes.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. I'll send it by 3:00 Pacific with the separate services billing note, the 12-month term, and the PO field called out. Then I'll hold March 18 with our onboarding team.
